_comment: 白井（デザイナー。実在の 社員が モデル）の 設定画。プロンプトは buildCharacterSheetPrompt(content/characters/shirai.json) の 出力を 逐語で 使い、参照の 役わりだけを 1行 足す。参照1＝本人の 写真（ネクストメイク公式サイトの 社員紹介）、参照2＝絵柄と 割りつけの 見本（湯川。人物は 写さない）。写真だけを 渡すと 線の 細い 写実よりの 絵に なり、ほかの 人物と 並ぶと 浮いた（2026-10-09 の 1回目）。

scenes.title: 白井の 設定画
scenes.scene:
A character model sheet for a Japanese language-learning manga.
Layout: front view (full body, T-pose) on the left, right side view and back view next to it,
and a column of 6 bust-up facial expressions on the right
(neutral, smiling, worried, surprised, thinking, apologetic).
White background. Light grid lines overlay to keep eye level consistent across views.
Character: デザイナー（Webデザインを 担当） — Japanese-style anime character, man in his mid thirties, medium build, relaxed cheerful posture. His face, hair and glasses are taken from the reference photograph — keep the same face shape, eyes and smile, drawn in anime style. Short black hair, textured and tousled upward on top with natural volume, neatly short on the sides. Round dark-brown tortoiseshell glasses with thin rims (boston shape). Fair skin, dark brown eyes that crinkle when he smiles, a wide bright smile showing his upper teeth, clean-shaven. Outfit: plain off-white crew-neck sweatshirt (#F3F1EA) with long sleeves and ribbed cuffs, no writing or logo on it; beige chino trousers (#CDBB9A); white low-top sneakers. Carries a slim silver tablet and a white stylus pen (he draws on it). No lanyard.
Personality (affects posture and expression): Webサイトの デザインを します。14年 似顔絵や イラストを かいて きました。入社して 最初の 月に、カンボジアで 似顔絵を かきました。新しい ことに よく 挑戦して、毎日 わくわくして います。ITと 絵を 合わせて、新しい ものを 作りたいと 考えて います。
Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, office and school settings, contemporary Japan.
Avoid: no text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image, speech balloons must be completely EMPTY (white inside, no writing), no watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border, no six fingers, no extra limbs, no costume changes between panels, no duplicate faces of the same character in one panel.
Do NOT write the character's name or any label on the sheet.
Reference images: the FIRST image is the real person this character is based on — follow his face, hair, round glasses and wide smile. Ignore the room, the chairs and the table in the photo. The SECOND image is only an example of the sheet layout and the drawing style (clean anime line art, soft flat cel shading, simple anime faces without realistic wrinkles or hatching) — match that style exactly, but do NOT copy that woman.
